name: Pi Coding Agent: Setup, Local Models and Comparison (2026)
description: Two dates matter if you follow older tutorials. The npm package moved from @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent, deprecated at version 0.73.1 in May 2026, to @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent. And Pi 1.0, released on 1 October 2026, added MCP and codemode, which changed one of Pi’s best-known design choices.
